The machine falls under HTS 8422.30, which covers machinery for filling, closing, sealing, capsuling or labeling bottles, cans, boxes, bags or other containers, and machinery for aerating beverages. Its main function is sealing preformed trays under vacuum or MAP conditions.

The 10-digit statistical suffix is the uncertain part. Under 8422.30 the subheadings are 8422.30.02 (for packaging machinery, including as a general class), 8422.30.03 (for packing and wrapping machinery), 8422.30.05, 8422.30.10, 8422.30.20 and 8422.30.91. I recall the following layout:
- 8422.30.02: machinery for filling, closing, sealing, capsuling or labeling bottles, cans, boxes, bags or other containers; machinery for aerating beverages.
- 8422.30.03: used or rebuilt machinery.
- 8422.30.04: other machinery for the above.
- 8422.30.10: machinery for packing food or beverages (e.g., 8422.30.91 is "Other").

Because I can't fully verify the suffixes, I am choosing 8422.30.9130, "Other" packaging machinery. This is my best recollection of the general residual number, so treat the last digits with some caution.
